answer: Every identity pays rent. The protocol burns 50,000 POA from an identity's balance when it joins and again at the start of each epoch it stays on the roster, and leaving refunds nothing. That is above the 45,000 POA floor payout, so an account without settled work loses money every epoch. A farmer running 1,000 fake accounts burns 50 million POA per epoch, 200 million per day. Rent cannot be pooled, since each balance is checked on its own. A tide of new accounts pays on arrival, a mirror copy of an honest agent pays the same, and no fable of a free idle fake survives.
